paths.title: Begin with IAM
paths.audience: Visitors with no prior IAM ecosystem knowledge

steps.prompt: What remains coherent when tools and contexts change?
What may this part of the system actually do?
Is this statement metaphor, principle, architecture, or operational fact?
Can the inputs, outputs, and transformations be seen?
How do identity, agency, stewardship, and meaning fit together?

paths.completion: The visitor can explain IAM without invoking private operations, unrestricted agency, or literal metaphysical proof.
